**[named bool] bare true/false in positional aggregate initialization**

Positional aggregate initialization of attention_operation_descriptor; the true binds to the member writes_kv [h/tron/models/kv_cache.hpp:263]. The rule text names constructor calls, and the file has the same bare form on many unchanged lines (611, 615, 626, 1240-1317, 1382, 1524, 1537, 1541, 2573), so the reviewer decides; a designated initializer (.writes_kv = true) would also carry the name.

Proposed:
```cpp
  constexpr bool WRITES_KV_TRUE = true;  // near the top of the test case
  const attention_operation_descriptor operation{
      {attention_op_id(0), model_layer_id(0), kv_slot_id(0)}, attention_kernel_id(0),
      attention_hardware_capability::software_only, WRITES_KV_TRUE,
      attention_operation_config{std::nullopt, std::nullopt, attention_scale}};
```
